en: The First Collection (Ekakanipāta), Chapter on the Woodpecker (Littavagga)
7. The Jātaka of the Attainment of Renown “Having seen Jīvaka dead and Dhanapāli in misery;”
"And Panthaka, who was lost in the forest,
has returned again, though he is wicked.
Thus ends the seventh Jātaka, the Nāmasiddhi Jātaka.
